name: askii
description: ASKII is an AI code assistant with style ( •_•)>⌐■-■ (⌐■_■)

askii.llmPlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII Ask, Edit and Do (ollama, lmstudio, openai, anthropic, opencodego, or askiicloud)

askii.llmModel.description: Model id to use for ASKII Ask, Edit and Do. Set to a model id supported by askii.llmPlatform (e.g. askii-smart, gpt-5-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6, glm-5.2, gemma4:e4b).

askii.llmInlinePlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII inline suggestions, inline completion and git commit message generation.

askii.llmInlineModel.description: Model id to use for ASKII inline suggestions, inline completion and git commit message generation.

askii.llmVisionPlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII Control (screen and browser) and Note (vision-capable features).

askii.llmVisionModel.description: Model id to use for ASKII Control (screen and browser) and Note (vision-capable features).

askii.ollamaUrl.description: URL of the Ollama API server

askii.lmStudioUrl.description: URL of the LM Studio API server

askii.openaiUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (leave empty for api.openai.com). Use this for Azure OpenAI or other compatible APIs.

enumDescriptions: Show relevant wiki documentation snippets (requires askii.wikiPath to be indexed)
askii.inlineHelperMode.description: Inline helper mode for code decorations

askii.doMaxRounds.description: Maximum number of interaction rounds for ASKII Do command

askii.doAutoConfirm.description: Automatically confirm create/modify/delete actions in ASKII Do without prompting

askii.formatAfterEdit.description: Automatically format files after ASKII Edit or ASKII Do creates/modifies them

askii.browserHeadless.description: Launch the Puppeteer browser in headless mode for ASKII Control browser mode (set to false to show the browser window)

askii.chromePath.description: Path to a Chromium-based browser executable for ASKII Control browser mode (e.g. C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe or C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe). Leave empty to auto-detect Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave.

askii.wikiEnabled.description: Enable wiki RAG context for Ask / Edit / Do commands. Requires askii.wikiPath to be set and the wiki to be indexed via ASKII: Reload Wiki.

askii.wikiPath.description: Path to folder containing .md documentation files used for wiki RAG context. Run 'ASKII: Reload Wiki' after changing this or updating the docs.

askii.wikiAutoReload.description: Automatically rebuild and reload the wiki index when the extension starts. Requires askii.wikiEnabled and askii.wikiPath to be configured.

askii.codeWikiEnabled.description: Enable code wiki — a vector index over workspace code (code files only) used as retrieval context for Ask / Edit / Do. Runs the embeddinggemma2 model locally (first index build downloads it once to ~/.askii/models); build the index via ASKII: Reload Wikis.

askii.codeWikiAutoReload.description: Automatically rebuild the code wiki index when the extension starts. Requires askii.codeWikiEnabled.

askii.inlineCompletionEnabled.description: Enable ASKII inline code completion (Copilot-style ghost text in the editor; Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss).

enumDescriptions: Trigger after 1200ms — fewer, more deliberate suggestions
askii.inlineCompletionEagerness.description: How eagerly ASKII requests inline completions. Controls the debounce delay and context window size.

askii.commitMessageInstructions.description: Path to a .md file with custom instructions for the commit message generator (injected as the system prompt, appended to the built-in rules). May be absolute or relative to the workspace root. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.

enumDescriptions: Generate a concise subject with an optional short body
Generate a fuller message with more descriptive context
askii.commitMessageStyle.description: Preferred output style for ASKII Git commit messages (OneLiner, Brief, or Descriptive).

askii.noteReminderSound.description: Play a sound when an ASKII Note reminder fires.

askii.noteSnoozeMinutes.description: Minutes to snooze an ASKII Note reminder when the user clicks 'Snooze' on the notification.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
